{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Methane''' was a gas that could be found in many [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and sometimes in solid ice form or even liquid lakes and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. It could even be found on [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], as was detected in some in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Notable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with methane included [[Skako/Legends|Skako]], [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]], [[Farstine]],<ref name="TRG1-9">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> [[Morseer]], [[Zaur (planet)|Zaur]], and [[Rue]], as well as coating [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the [[Crispin asteroid field]].

[[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri's]] [[Oort Cloud|oort cloud]] had methane-ice comets.<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

[[Lactil]]s exhaled large amounts of methane, which caused storms on [[Chad/Legends|Chad]].<ref name="QotE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

It was used for many purposes, such as powering [[Boat/Legends|boats]] on Chad. [[Drackmarian]]s and [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerians]] were both methane breathing [[Species/Legends|species]].
